verdict.rationale: QuickBooks Online documents custom workflows and community users mention bank rules, but nothing in the evidence shows versioning, review, or rollback of those automations. The Advanced plan's 'backup and restore to undo mistakes' covers company data in general, not automation definitions, so it is an adjacent feature and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
